svg.text: park all ten valves where a dead controller would leave them
start on irr_dueTray, if the modulation gives a dose
inlet and one tray open, to the dose or to the timeout
at the END of the fill: a restart in the long drain must not water the tray twice
both ends shut; skipped when the soak is zero
judge what came back against the dose that went in
both ends open, no tray: clear the shared manifold
